title: FrontDesk AI clinic file
description: The clinic file: clinic-data.json shipped with the app, or the edited copy saved from the staff page (the one row of the Postgres table clinic_data, and this device's copy in localStorage key frontdesk.clinic). This schema follows the server's check before a save (checkClinic in api/_store.js): a JSON object under 100,000 characters with the required parts below. The browser's own check (validateClinic in core.js) looks at the shape only: an object with a clinic section; hours and policies, when present, are sections; services and doctors, when present, are lists. The engine also reads the same facts in other shapes (cost for price, specialty for role, hours as objects, policies as a list) and fills a field that is left out, so no reply prints an empty value. Extra fields are kept; the first 12,000 characters of the file go to the wording model.

note.description: Free text about the file. Not read by the rules engine.

emergency_phone.description: First thing in an emergency reply.

hours.description: Each key names one or more days (for example monday_to_saturday, sunday) and each value is the timing text. lunch_break and public_holidays are read when the question asks for them.

price.description: Copied into the reply as written.

policies.description: The shipped file has appointments, walk_ins, payment, emi, insurance, children, first_visit and sterilisation. Any other key is answered when the question names it.

emergency_rules.description: Added after the emergency number in an emergency reply. An emergency named only here is also treated as one.

bot_rules.description: Not read by the rules engine; sent to the model with the rest of the file.

assistant.description: Optional; not in the shipped file. Sets the assistant's name and the clinic's own quick replies.
